note: The welcome note a sasquatch leaves on the sill on a visitor's first visit (note_brief.md; drawn by anim/scripts/note.py). Sheets are single rows of equal frames. Position each so its anchor point lands on the placement x,y; sheets with anchor [0,0] are placed by their top-left corner.

note_deliver.note: First visit only, plays once. A sasquatch arm reaches in from the LEFT at mid-window height, lowers the note to the sill and lets go on release_frame, then pulls back out. Drawn BEFORE cabin_window, so the frame hides where the arm comes in from outside. The note it lets go of is note_sill, drawn after cabin_window from release_frame on (the copy in this sheet lies behind the sill).

note_sill.note: Static folded note on the sill (with its 2 px shadow). Clickable: opens the welcome note. Gone for good once read.

note_open.note: The note unfolding before the welcome note opens; replaces note_sill while it plays. Frame 0 is note_sill exactly, so the anchor lines it up on the same spot.
